title: See Seville thru a Spanish Lens
text: Interesting and good pictures afforded us on our visit. Our tour guide even broke out his own camera to show us the day Columbus's chest in his tomb was opened and how the bones of Columbus were matched 99% to his other descendants (his sons) who are all buried (in the Cathedral) after many changes of where the tomb was buried. Very KNOWLEDGEABLE guide of the history, culture and important sights to see. VERY EFFICIENT with the time provided as we toured the palace & cathedral. Thank you!!
author: Celeste_S

title: Adriana was a font of knowledge!
text: Adriana was WONDERFUL! She, obviously, loves history and stories from the past. She shared he avid interest with us and made our tour excellent!
author: Eliza_B

title: Alcazar - Wow
text: The visit to the cathedral was disappointing; however, the Alcazar is one of the most beautiful things I have seen, and Susana is an exceptional guide.
author: Josee_R

title: Memorable Friday Afternoon Tour
text: Although initially we initially had some confusion with the tour guide[s], the afternoon ended up much better than we anticipated. Due to some scheduling issues, we ended up with two different guides. The first tour was small and although the guide was professional and knowledgeable, she appeared at times distracted. The second guide saved the day, she was entertaining, humorous, knowledgeable and engaging. The second group was over 12 people and she herded us through the church like a pro. She shared her knowledge of the church through animation and stories, which I am sure all of us will now
author: John_B

title: We avoided a...
text: We avoided an endless queue and our guide Suzanna is great and passionate. It was a wonderful moment to discover and understand this civilization.
author: mariejosephe_h

title: Awesome tour
text: An amazing experience provided by Alejandro. He was exceptionally knowledgeable and kept the group interested.
author: Stewart_S

title: Spectacular Views
text: Our group enjoyed our tours with Clara, who sarcastic humor, made the tour even more enjoyable for us.  She took us all around the Alcazar providing great informational tips and stunning views.  She proved to us that the Cathedral next door was the largest one in the world.  Then we finished up the tour taking the challenge to go up the Giralda tower (35 floors).  It was just the right amount of time for us freeing us up the rest of the day, but getting to enjoy some of the most stunning views in Seville.
author: Ross_O

title: The guide makes it a better experience
text: Our guide, Clara, was knowledgeable, made the tour personal by asking where we were all from and then calling us by that name, and had a great sense of humor.
author: Rochelle_T

title: Clara was great….,
text: This tour was absolutely the correct length and our guide Clara was excellent.  Her humor was appropriate and made the experience less dry than it might have been.
author: Todd_T

title: Royal alcazar
text: First of all we loved our guide Clara and she is amazing, funny and very knowledgeable. Me and my friend gained so much of insight about the history of Spain. Highly recommended tour
author: Deepika_S
